$schema_note: Full-corpus format contract for Sumo process-unit workbooks. Measured 2026-09-06 over all 236 process-unit workbooks (5 categories) + 51 contrast workbooks (Energy 11, Hidden 28, Plantwide 12) + 84 Group Info files. openpyxl read-only. Raw census: .scratch/sumoslang-unit-authoring/artifacts/census_full.json. This file supersedes the 02a pilot cut; neither generator nor linter may carry hardcoded header strings of its own.

writer_library.reason: openpyxl emits t=inlineStr and drops sharedStrings.xml => SMT 'File error'; xlsxwriter emits t=s + sharedStrings.xml => SMT loads and produces byte-identical XML to Excel COM output.

sheet_order.canonical: Help | Unit | Parameters | Code | Display | Popup

rules.Help_first: Help is always the first sheet (287/287).
rules.tail: Display then Popup are the tail in the canonical order, but NOT universal: Hidden units (no Display/Popup, 12x 'Help|Unit|Parameters|Structure|Code'), ChildU sub-units (no Display/Popup), 2x 'Popup|Display' reversal (SodiumBicarbonate).
rules.Structure_slot: dominant position is after Code (38+3+1 of 53); Energy units + Hidden units + Metal chemicals place Structure between Parameters and Code.
rules.Components_slot: dominant position between Parameters and Code (37); 2x before Parameters (Drawdown Gen3 Facultative Pond, Gen3 Facultative Pond); 1x after Code (Response time).

Unit.note: vertical stack of blocks; each block = title in column B, description in C, then header row, then data rows
Unit.header_row: variable (each block has its own); first block at row 3

Parameters.note: vertical stack of section blocks; title in column C of the row above the header
Parameters.header_row: 3 for the first block; variable thereafter

Code.note: vertical sections; section title in column A, Codelocation(...) in column D of the section-header row (row above the Symbol header); then header row, then data rows. Codelocation grammar is ticket 03a/03b material: 'Dynamic' is 89.6% of all tags.

Display.note: block title in C2, Location(...) in D2; header row 3

Popup.note: block title in C2, Location(...) in D2; header row 3

Structure.note: two blocks. Block 1: 'Unit components' - sub-model toggles; block 2: 'Internal connection' table. Toggle column set is NOT install-fixed (11 distinct variants observed).

Components.note: ONLY sheet whose table does NOT start in column B - header starts at column C.

Functions.note: 1 unit only (Plantwide units/Statistics/Noise.xlsx); C++ function definitions

table_grammar.block_structure: each sheet is a vertical stack of blocks; block = optional title row + header row + data rows; blocks separated by blank rows.
table_grammar.data_rows: follow the header until a blank row
table_grammar.start_column: B for every table EXCEPT Components (starts at C)

Position.note: a second form '97;50' appears in the Size field of some units - not a position.

Rule.note: semicolon-joined flag tokens; function-call forms; NOT a closed list (1249 distinct).

Decimals.note: display-precision integer 0-5 (rare 6); ignored by the SMT; workbook UI convention.

rows.DefaultUnit: present 84/84, names the default unit workbook in the folder

group_info_contract.naming: folder contains '<name> Group Info.xlsx' + one or more unit workbooks; C2 is usually the folder base name; DefaultUnit names the default unit.

symbol_grammar.unicode: Greek letters load-bearing (alpha, beta, eta, theta, lambda, kappa, gamma, tau, rho, Delta, Theta); U+019E 'eta-substitute' used throughout the Granular SBR family

encoding.writer_handling: xlsxwriter writes Unicode natively; the emitter must copy symbols/units verbatim (never transliterate Greek).

exceptions.Popup_before_Display: 20 Flow elements/Chemicals/SodiumBicarbonate.xlsx orders Popup before Display
exceptions.Components_before_Parameters: Drawdown Gen3 Facultative Pond.xlsx; Gen3 Facultative Pond.xlsx
exceptions.Structure_between_Parameters_and_Code: Energy units (9), Hidden units (12+), Metal chemicals Al2(SO4)3.xlsx & AlCl3.xlsx
exceptions.no_Display_Popup: Hidden units (mostly Help|Unit|Parameters|Structure|Code); ChildU_TricklingFilter*.xlsx (Help|Unit|Parameters|Code); EmptyInputRiver/Sewer (Help|Unit|Parameters); Model checker PU & SV mapper (Help|Unit|Code); CFP off*.xlsx (Help|Unit)
exceptions.Group_Info_case: Deflocculator/Deflocculator Group info.xlsx uses lowercase 'info' - excluded from unit corpus by case-insensitive filter
exceptions.unicode_unit_spellings: W/m2 vs W/m²; m3 vs m³; %v.v-1 vs %v/v vs v/v%; l.s-1 vs l/s vs l s-1; g.m-3 vs g O2/m3
